title: 空想の生きもの 切り絵風
subject_en: ORIGINAL imaginary fantasy creatures invented for this series, each a separate creature in layered paper-cut style with 4 to 6 colours, distinct silhouette, calm friendly faces, no weapons. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters.
lead: 雲のくじら、星をくわえたきつね、森のかさ鹿。オリジナルの空想の生きもの12点を、切り絵のように重ねた紙のタッチで。絵本、ポスター、ゲームの素材に。
items: a whale whose body is a fluffy cloud, with tiny stars along the back
a fox with a large tail holding a small yellow star in its mouth
a deer whose antlers are tree branches with leaves and tiny mushrooms
a rabbit with a crescent moon shaped ear curl
a big turtle with a tiny island of trees on its shell
a flying fish with wing-like fins and a rainbow tail
an owl with a glowing lantern belly
a small round friendly dragon with tiny wings and a curled tail
a bear covered with berry bushes on its back
a white-and-blue bird with a long snowflake-patterned tail
a cat with flowers blooming along its spine
a pale horse with a mane made of swirling wind lines
